title: Starting a game
summary: Shuffle, draw seven, mulligan if needed. The first player skips their first draw.

checklist.label: I know how to set up a game
I know how a mulligan works
I know the first player skips their first draw

steps.title: Setting up
steps.body:
Before the first turn:

- Each player shuffles their [[deck]]. It becomes their [[library]].
- Each player starts at **20 life**.
- Decide who goes first. Often a coin flip or dice roll picks a player, who then chooses.
- Each player draws **seven cards**.

visual.src: Two players shuffling, two life counters at 20, a coin flip, and seven cards being drawn.
visual.altText: The four set-up steps: shuffle, 20 life, choose who goes first, draw seven.

steps.title: Mulligans
steps.body:
Not happy with your opening seven? You can [[mulligan]].

Shuffle your hand back into your library and draw a fresh seven. Then put **one card** from that hand on the bottom of your library for **each** mulligan you took.

You may mulligan more than once, but your hand gets smaller each time. A good hand usually has 2 to 5 lands.

visual.src: A hand with only one land being shuffled away, a new hand of seven drawn, and one card going to the bottom of the library.
visual.altText: A mulligan: new seven cards, then one card to the bottom.

check.question: You mulligan twice, then keep. How many cards do you put on the bottom of your library?
check.hint: One card for each mulligan you took.

steps.title: The first turn
steps.body:
The player who goes first **skips the draw on their first turn**. This balances out the advantage of going first.

After that, every player draws one card at the start of each of their turns, in the draw step.

visual.src: Turn 1: the first player's draw step is crossed out. Turn 2: the other player draws a card.
visual.altText: The first player skipping their first draw.

check.question: You go first. Do you draw a card on your first turn?
check.hint: Going first is an advantage, so something balances it out.
